design.quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to assess the association between vitamin D status and left ventricular remodeling

population.quote: to evaluate whether vitamin D supplementation improves remodeling-related cardiac parameters in adults with CKD

sample_size.quote: Sixteen studies were included: seven observational studies involving 1,487 participants and nine interventional studies involving 581 participants.

intervention.quote: evaluate whether vitamin D supplementation improves remodeling-related cardiac parameters

primary_findings.quote: higher vitamin D levels were associated with lower LVMI (r = -0.41, 95% confidence interval [CI]: -0.64 to -0.11)
Vitamin D supplementation did not significantly improve LVMI (standardized mean difference [SMD] = -0.20, 95% CI: -0.62 to 0.22)
A possible reduction in IVST was observed (SMD = -0.68, 95% CI: -1.32 to -0.05)

limitations_stated.value: heterogeneity was substantial and the certainty of evidence was very low
limitations_stated.quote: although heterogeneity was substantial and the certainty of evidence was very low

limitations_stated.value: this finding was based on limited and inconsistent evidence
limitations_stated.quote: but this finding was based on limited and inconsistent evidence
